plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Teldat router. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 2007).
name: Router

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilisation of the Teldat router over the last 5 minutes (teldatCPUBusy5min), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage_1min
metrics.description: CPU utilisation of the Teldat router over the last 1 minute (teldatCPUBusy1min), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage.

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage_5sec
metrics.description: CPU utilisation of the Teldat router over the last 5 seconds (teldatCPUBusy5sec), reported directly as a 0-100 percentage.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total cache memory of the Teldat router in bytes (telProdNpMonSistemMemTotalcache).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free cache memory of the Teldat router in bytes (telProdNpMonSistemMemFreecache).

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilisation of the Teldat router, derived as (total-free)/total from cache memory scalars.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
